[SWS_EM_02297] StateClient usage restriction
Upstream requirements:
RS_EM_00101
⌈
StateClient
API shall treat it as a StateClientUsageRestrictionViolation when in-
voked by a
Process
with
Process
.
functionClusterAffiliation
configured to
anything else than STATE_MANAGEMENT.
⌋
If not protected
StateClient
can be used to destabilise
Machine
.
